_note: Draft from the app's published vulnerability list; confirm each entry against the decompiled app.

expected.CFG-001: PostLogin, DoTransfer, ViewStatement, a content provider and a broadcast receiver are exported
expected.LOG-001: logs the username and password on login
expected.STO-001: stores the (reversibly encrypted) credentials in SharedPreferences
expected.STO-004: keeps user data in a plaintext SQLite database
expected.NET-001: talks to its backend over cleartext http
expected.CRY-006: AES-CBC with a hardcoded all-zero IV
expected.CRY-008: AES key built from a hardcoded string
